title: Restore displaced Anchorpoint station position
evidence: Authored REFR DATA in SFBGS00D.esm supplied with Starfield 1.16.244. The affected save contained an approximately 1.535e12-unit displaced position in the correct cell.
limitations: Repairs the saved position only. Does not reset docking links, Havok, scripts, or quests. Recovery reported by one player on 2026-11-13; detailed docking and save/reload persistence were not independently recorded.
